name: design-system
oneLiner: A personal design system: tokens and React components every side project consumes, starting with job-radar.
highlights: Token pipeline from one Style Dictionary source to CSS custom properties, Sass, typed TypeScript and JSON, with light and dark themes and a density switch.
Every text and surface pair is verified against WCAG AA in both themes by a unit test, not by eye.
Seven accessible React components on headless primitives: visible focus rings, 44px touch targets, reduced-motion support and logical properties for RTL.
Visual language specified first in a Claude Design artifact, then coded; the repo's token source is the source of truth after the first publish.
